digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Today moved key rollout and portfolio work forward, but the dashboard still has a concentrated set of unresolved governance and close-out items. Tomorrow's afternoon calendar will require deliberate coverage.

items.label: Close Denver go-live acceptance and analytics ownership
items.detail: Denver moved into controlled launch with Amazon Connect handling inbound calls and RingCentral remaining the interim outbound path. Confirm call stability, resolve the remaining AI Insights and caller-ID questions, and record owners and escalation coverage.

items.label: Remediate the critical Supabase security warning
items.detail: A fresh security-vulnerability notice arrived today. Verify the affected project and table protections, address the warning, and confirm the alert clears.

items.label: Set the remaining MHE rollout ownership
items.detail: The M2 milestone is signed off and the re-baselined dates are locked. Confirm the work Angel and Shane own within the compliance portion, then assign owners and dates for the remaining intake, disclosure, task-set, provider-state, and rollout work.

items.label: Close the Quality intake-governance loop
items.detail: Record the agreed intake path, ownership, and treatment of the Denial/RFE categorization work as the broader CoE discussion continues.

items.label: Complete the LeadUp growth-mindset follow-up survey
items.detail: Finish the aging follow-up survey before Module 4 work displaces it again.

items.label: Confirm the Cross-Firm Lead Intake project name
items.detail: Confirm that CLIP is the Cross-Firm Lead Intake project and keep the February 1, 2027 discovery target consistent in the portfolio record.

items.label: Verify the team's Toggl month-end close
items.detail: Check the October report for visible gaps and follow up only with teammates whose entries remain incomplete.

items.label: Decide Eugenia's CoE OKRs dashboard access
items.detail: Approve the appropriate permission level or route the request to the dashboard owner so Eugenia can use the Q4 CoE view.

items.label: Close the remaining portfolio-document and handoff loops
items.detail: Confirm Jorge's portfolio update has no remaining status, owner, or risk gaps, and verify whether Sara still needs additional feedback on the post-discovery Product-to-EPMO handoff.

items.label: Confirm the new BD Portfolio Review time
items.detail: A new time was proposed today after the earlier invitation was declined. Secure the final meeting time this week and preserve the owner, priority, and risk decisions the review needs to close.

items.label: 10:30-11:00 AM - Thiago 1:1
items.detail: Carry Denver's launch findings into the discussion and confirm the owners for any overnight stability, analytics, or rollout follow-ups.

items.label: Noon-2:00 PM - Focus time and Mar 1:1
items.detail: Protect the noon focus block, then use the 1:30 PM 1:1 to clear portfolio and CoE follow-through.

items.label: 3:00-3:30 PM - EPMO Team Meeting
items.detail: Bring the concise rollout, portfolio, and ownership updates needed for the team discussion.

items.label: 3:30-4:30 PM - Firmwide meeting and 4:00 PM conflict
items.detail: The Firmwide Meeting overlaps both weekly-meeting preparation and the Amazon Connect standup at 4:00 PM. Choose coverage and secure the deployment readout in advance.
